  words := text/lines(x)

  size := sequence/length(joined)
  counts := map/histogram(words)
  keys := map/keys(counts)
  values := map/values(counts)
  formatted := number/format(size + sequence/length(values), 0u64)
  next := (choose? | true => text/join(keys, formatted) | false => x).
seed<string> |2> step

formatted := number/format(size, 0u64)

values := map/values(counts)
more := size + 1u64
unique<{string}> := keys
present := "a" ∈ unique
absent := "never" ∉ unique
count := (present? | true => counts{"a"} | false => 0u64)
first := (size? | 0u64 => 0u64 | * => values[1u64])
constructed := {"live": more, "next": size + 2u64, "last": size + 3u64, "wider": size + 4u64}
constructed-value := constructed{"next"}
packed := (count, first, present, absent)
quotient := more / divisor<u64>
